gaps.sentence: Tax is calculated on your total annual ___.
gaps.hint: all the money you receive from every source
gaps.explanation: 'Income' is all the money you receive from work, investments, rent and so on during a period.

gaps.sentence: The money was divided ___ the four children.
gaps.hint: for a group of more than two
gaps.explanation: 'Among' is traditionally used for more than two; 'between' is preferred for exactly two.

gaps.sentence: This tooth is ___ and will probably fall out soon.
gaps.explanation: 'Loose' is an adjective meaning not firmly fixed; 'lose' is the verb meaning to no longer have.

gaps.sentence: Teenagers ___ hours every day on social media.
gaps.hint: to use time or money on something (neutral)
gaps.explanation: 'Spend time/money on something' is the neutral verb for using time or money; 'waste' implies useless use.

gaps.sentence: They managed to ___ the champions in the final.
gaps.explanation: 'Beat' takes the opponent as object (beat the champions); 'win' takes the game or prize.

gaps.sentence: Please ___ me to post this letter.
gaps.hint: make somebody not forget: ___ somebody to do something
gaps.explanation: 'Remind somebody to do something' means to make someone remember; 'remember' is something you do yourself.

gaps.sentence: The new law will ___ every driver in the country.
gaps.explanation: 'Affect' is the verb meaning to have an influence on; 'effect' is normally a noun meaning a result.

gaps.sentence: A car remained ___ at the traffic lights for ages.
gaps.explanation: 'Stationary' means not moving; 'stationery' means pens, paper and other writing materials.
